name: What is the difference between basic drywall repair and drywall restoration?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between basic drywall repair and drywall restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall restoration goes beyond basic cosmetic patching to address widespread, structural, or water-related wall damage. While a basic patch covers small nail holes or minor doorknob dents using joint compound, restoration involves cutting away damaged sections, securing framing, hanging new drywall panels, taping, mudding, and matching the existing wall texture. It is often required after plumbing leaks, roof leaks, mold remediation, or settling cracks. At HH Remodeling LLC, our crews handle the complete transition, integrating rough framing adjustments, drywall hanging, skim coating, and final interior painting so the repaired wall blends seamlessly with the surrounding surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall restoration rebuilds larger structural, water-damaged, or textured wall sections from framing to paint, whereas standard repair only fills minor surface holes.
